checks.check: each matrix swaps its two pairs of marks (homogeneous coordinates)
all three are traceless: rotations by pi about a geodesic of hyperbolic three-space
they anticommute pairwise for every cross ratio: three mutually orthogonal axes through one point
the product of two is proportional to the third: Klein four-group in PSL(2,C), quaternion frame in SL(2,C)
the three generators do not commute: [A, B] = 2AB is the third one
their complex span is sl(2,C) = so(3,1): three boosts and three rotations, no translation
a common fixed point exists (invariant positive Hermitian form) for generic, harmonic and equianharmonic marks
verdict D: four marks give a Lorentz frame (three orthogonal axes and an observer) kinematically, for any four points; commuting translations do not arise
positive spin form (reflection positive data): every closed chain F_x F_y has real nonnegative spectrum, 2000 random cases
then no pair of points is spacelike in the causal-fermion sense (that needs a non-real spectrum): no causal distinction
scalar evaluations (rank one, either sign): the closed chain has one real eigenvalue s_x s_y |<x|y>|^2, never a non-real pair
with the mirrored pair and the swap form (signature (1,1)) both spacelike and timelike pairs occur
each F_w then has one positive and one negative eigenvalue; on the mirror line it degenerates to rank one
verdict 7: with the source's positive forms the causal structure is trivial; the first nontrivial case needs the reflected copy, a chosen kernel and a chosen measure
